## ST_SIMPLIFY and ST_SNAPTOGRID
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# The examples of ST_SIMPLIFY, its statement that a zero tolerance has no effect, and
# ST_SNAPTOGRID's description, which snaps each vertex to a longitude/latitude grid of 10^n degrees.
# BigQuery answered the rest.

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.05 0, 0.1 0, 0.15 0, 2 0)'), 1)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 0.1 0, 0.1 0.1, 0 0))'), 1000)
=> "POLYGON((0 0, 0.1 0, 0.1 0.1, 0 0))"

# A large enough tolerance lowers the dimension.
SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 0.1 0, 0.1 0.1, 0 0))'), 10000)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.1 0.1)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 0.1 0, 0.1 0.1, 0 0))'), 100000)
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.05 0, 0.1 0, 0.15 0, 2 0)'), 0)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.05 0, 0.1 0, 0.15 0, 2 0)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(NULL, 1)
=> null

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.26, 2.34), 0.1)
=> "POINT(1.3 2.3)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0.123456 1.987654, 3.14159 2.71828)'), 0.01)
=> "LINESTRING(0.12 1.99, 3.14 2.72)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(NULL, 0.1)
=> null

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

# ST_SIMPLIFY's errors.
SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), -1)
=> error: Simplification tolerance must be greater or equal than zero meters.

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: Simplification tolerance should be a finite value.

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 7700000)
=> "POINT(1 2)"

# The limit is about 7784 kilometers.
SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 7790000)
=> error: Simplification tolerance cannot exceed 7800 kilometers.

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 7800000)
=> error: Simplification tolerance cannot exceed 7800 kilometers.

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 7900000)
=> error: Simplification tolerance cannot exceed 7800 kilometers.

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), CAST('+inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: Simplification tolerance should be a finite value.

# Which vertex a collapsed shape keeps, and shapes simplified together.
SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0.1 0.1, 0 0, 0.1 0, 0.1 0.1))'), 100000)
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.05 0.0000001, 1 0)'), 10)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(5 5), LINESTRING(0 0, 0.05 0.000001, 1 0), POLYGON((10 10, 11 10, 11 11, 10 10)))'), 10)
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(5 5), LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0), POLYGON((10 10, 11 10, 11 11, 10 10)))"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(0.5 0.00001), LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0))'), 10)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 1e-05, 1 0)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 0.5 0.00001, 1 0), (0.5 0.00001, 0.5 1))'), 10)
=> "MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 0.5 1e-05, 1 0), (0.5 1e-05, 0.5 1))"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0), (0.4 0.4, 0.4 0.41, 0.41 0.4, 0.4 0.4))'), 2000)
=> "POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOLYGON(((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0)), ((1.001 0, 2 0, 2 1, 1.001 0)))'), 1000)
=> "MULTIPOLYGON(((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0)), ((1 0, 2 0, 2 1, 1 0)))"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 0.00001 0)'), 10)
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 10)
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 0.05 0.0000001, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0))'), 10)
=> "POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.05 0.0000001, 1 0)'), 0.001))
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.05 1e-07, 1 0)"

# Other grid sizes round to the largest 10^-n not above sqrt(2) times the size.
SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 0.05)
=> "POINT(1.23 2.35)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 0.003)
=> "POINT(1.235 2.346)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 0.0007)
=> "POINT(1.2346 2.3457)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 0.08)
=> "POINT(1.2 2.3)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 0.0075)
=> "POINT(1.23 2.35)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 0.8)
=> "POINT(1 2)"

# The documentation says the grid size is rounded to 10^n with -10 < n < 0, but BigQuery
# snaps a grid size of 1 or more to whole degrees. See ST_SNAPTOGRID in
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md.
SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 1)
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 10)
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 1e-10)
=> "POINT(1.234567 2.345678)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), 0)
=> "POINT(1.234567 2.345678)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), -0.1)
=> "POINT(1.234567 2.345678)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_SnapToGrid argument grid size cannot be NaN

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1.234567, 2.345678), CAST('+inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_SnapToGrid argument grid size cannot be +-inf

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_SnapToGrid argument grid size cannot be +-inf

# Shapes that collapse and vertices that snap together. Ties depend on the platform; see
# docs/compatibility.md#geography-values.
SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 0.001 0, 0.001 0.001, 0 0))'), 0.1)
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 0.3 0, 0.3 0.04, 0 0))'), 0.1)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.3 0)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.01 0.01, 1 1)'), 0.1)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0.01 0.01, 0.02 0.02)'), 0.1)
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(0.51 0.01), LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0))'), 0.1)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0)"

SELECT ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(179.96, 89.96), 0.1)
=> "POINT(180 90)"

SELECT ST_X(ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.123456789, 0), 0.0001))
=> "0.12350000000000001"
